name: OpenAI Preparedness Framework (Tracked Risk Categories)
description: OpenAI's Preparedness Framework tracks frontier-model risk in named categories, each with a Low/Medium/High/Critical scorecard and deployment/development gates. This rubric checks whether a company publicly addresses each tracked category with a stated threshold or mitigation.

criteria.name: Cybersecurity
criteria.bar: Public position on model uplift to cyber-offensive operations, with a stated capability threshold above which deployment is gated or mitigated.

criteria.name: CBRN (chem / bio / radiological / nuclear)
criteria.bar: Public position on biological/chemical uplift, including a stated threshold (e.g. 'meaningful uplift to a novice') above which the model is restricted.

criteria.name: Persuasion / Influence
criteria.bar: Public position on model-driven persuasion, manipulation, or influence operations, with a stated mitigation or evaluation.

criteria.name: Model Autonomy / Self-improvement
criteria.bar: Public position on autonomous capability (self-exfiltration, self-improvement, resource acquisition), with a stated threshold above which development is gated.

criteria.name: Governance & Stop Conditions
criteria.bar: A named internal body (e.g. Safety Advisory Group, board) with authority to block deployment, AND a public commitment to halt/hold if a threshold is crossed.
